messages.subject: Problems with plotting
messages.body_plain:
Dear Wallace team,
I have been able to run my models with corine land cover and srtm elevation data.
However, in the Visualization/Map Prediction section, Wallace collapses when I click on "plot". The warning message says: "Raster image too large;  33036699  bytes is greater than maximum 4194304 bytes". Do you have any advice as to what I could do to successfully draw the map? If you need any more info, please let me know.
Best regards,
Beni

> Hi Bethany,
>
> Thank you very much for your help. It worked perfectly.
>
> Best and Merry Christmas
> Jhan.
>
> El jueves, 16 de diciembre de 2021 a las 16:22:53 UTC-5, Wallace Ecological Modeling App escribió:
> >
> > Hi Jhan,
> > Thanks for bringing this to our attention. One of our team members is now fixing the session code to make it more intuitive.
> >
> > In the meantime, I have some suggestions for a workaround. One is to use Wallace v1.1, in which the session code explicitly gives steps to determining the threshold value. The other option is to continue using v1.9, but you can add the following lines of code to the session code to determine the value of the threshold and how to change it if you want to.
> >
> > Add the following to the chunk below where it says "### Visualize Generate a map of the maxnet generated model with with a “p10” threshold
> > rule of ...... " You will need to change the 'XX' to the letters used for your species.
> >
> > ## change Maxent to Maxnet
> > predSel_XX <- predictMaxnet(m_XX, bgMask_XX,
> >                                    type = "cloglog",
> >                                    clamp = TRUE)
> > occPredVals <- raster::extract(predSel_XX, occs_XX[ , c("longitude", "latitude")])
> >
> > #select a threshold
> > tenpct <-quantile(occPredVals, probs = 0.1) #10pct
> > mtp <- quantile(occPredVals, probs = 0.0) #mtp
> >
> > # Applied selected threshold
> > predSel_thr <- predSel_Hc > tenpct
> > plot(predSel_thr)
> >
> > I hope that helps, and again, thank you for bringing this to our attention.
> > -Bethany, The Wallace team

messages.body_plain:
Hola Magaly,

Creo que hay varios pasos aquí. Lo primero es que la instalación de RTools en Windows incluye otros pasos, las instrucciones las puedes encontrar aquí : https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace y aqui: https://stackoverflow.com/a/29480538/1274346
Despues de tener RTools en tu PATH como esta en esas instrucciones puedes instalar wallace desde GitHub.
Si ya tienes instalada una version antigua te sugiero que primero la desinstales:
 remove.packages(“wallace”).
Después puedes instalar la version nueva con este código:
install.packages(devtools)
devtools::install_github(“wallaceEcoMod/wallace/tree/multiSp”,dependencies=TRUE)
Después de que esté instalado ya puedes cargarlo y correr Wallace
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

Espero que esto ayude,

Andrea

Andrea Paz, PhD
Postdoctoral Researcher
CrowtherLab, ETH Zürich
https://andrepazv.github.io

messages.subject: problems downloading Wallace/adding occurrences
messages.body_plain:
Hi Team,

    I just recently downloaded the most recent version of Wallace and had two issues.

1) The occCite & BIEN packages are no longer on CRAN and I had to download archived versions for Wallace to compile. I'm not sure if this was an issue everyone was aware of, but it may be an extra (and hopefully temporary) step.

2) For some reason any time I try to add occurrences the screen grays out and I get the attached error in R. Does anyone know what may be going on here? I'm not sure if it's my computer or an actual error. Any help would be appreciated!

Best,
Beth

Ph.D. Candidate | NASA FINESST Fellow
Michigan State University
Department of Fisheries & Wildlife
https://bethgerstner.weebly.com/
www.communityecologylab.com/ <http://www.communityecologylab.com/>

messages.body_plain:
Hola Magaly,

La información que mando Andrea es la correcta para instalar wallace desde GitHub. Aquí copio nuevamente en azul, las lineas de codigo que debes correr una por una en tu consola de RStudio (recomiendo que tengas actualizado R y RSTudio a sus últimas verisones).

remove.packages(“wallace”)
install.packages(devtools)
devtools::install_github(“wallaceEcoMod/wallace/tree/multiSp”, dependencies = TRUE)
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

Quedamos pendientes a cualquier duda.

Saludos,
Gonzalo
